tasks.desc: Rewrite WeightingParams / DEFAULT_WEIGHTING_PARAMS / PARAM_META in WeightingConfigDialog.tsx to the 9 param_configs.py params (types/defaults/options/labels). Remove the 5 placeholders.
Extend the dialog render to support switch + select controls (not just number); keep nullable handling for JERARQUIA_MIN_COLAPSO. Reuse src/components/ui Switch + Select.
Centralize param descriptors in src/modules/pesaje/weightingParams.ts (type + defaults + WEIGHTING_PARAM_FIELDS). Re-export from WeightingConfigDialog for import stability.
Make WeightingDetailModal re-run editor type-aware (number/select/switch via descriptors; fall back for unknown keys) so enum/bool params don't corrupt on re-run. Fix any references to removed keys.
Unit tests (vitest): defaults shape, control rendering, reset behavior.
Playwright e2e: run a country and assert parameters_json carries the 9 keys.
Run VERIFY_CMD + Playwright against mock+dev until green.
